_comment: 口パク 6枚（VisemeFace）。設定画だけを 参照に 渡す。プロンプトは build_mouth_ledgers.ts が buildMouthPrompt() から 作る（手で 直さない）。生の 6枚は composite_mouth.mjs で 閉じた 口の 絵に 口だけ 重ねてから 置く。

scenes.title: okuda の 口パク（closed）
scenes.scene:
A bust-up portrait for a talking-head animation frame.

Character: プログラマー（お客さまの 会社で はたらく） — Japanese-style anime character, man in his mid twenties, medium build, relaxed posture. Wavy messy black hair with volume. Black rectangular thick-rimmed glasses. Fair skin, dark brown eyes, calm gentle smile. Outfit: dark green pullover hoodie (#2E4034) with drawstrings and no writing on it, dark trousers, grey sneakers.

Framing: head and shoulders, facing the camera straight on, centered,
eyes looking at the camera, neutral friendly expression.
Background: a single flat muted blue-grey color (#b8c9db), like a plain office wall.
No gradient, no pattern, no props.

Mouth: mouth closed, relaxed gentle smile.
Everything else (background color, hair, eyes, eyebrows, head angle, clothing, framing, lighting)
must be EXACTLY the same as the reference image. Change ONLY the mouth.

Style: clean modern Japanese manga / anime style, soft cel shading, bright friendly palette, rounded shapes, no harsh shadows, office and school settings, contemporary Japan.
Avoid: no text, no letters, no kanji, no kana, no numbers anywhere in the image, speech balloons must be completely EMPTY (white inside, no writing), no watermark, no signature, no logo, no frame border, no six fingers, no extra limbs, no costume changes between panels, no duplicate faces of the same character in one panel.
